titulo.estudio: Un échange en ligne : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: An online exchange: Finding the details

intro: Work out intention, references and replies in a short written conversation. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Camille : « Le nouvel atelier de céramique est complet. Vous y êtes déjà allé ? »
frases.alumno: Camille: «The new pottery workshop is full. Have you already been there?»

frases.estudio: Nabil : « Oui, j'y suis allé mardi; on y apprend à fabriquer une tasse. »
frases.alumno: Nabil: «Yes, I went on Tuesday; you learn to make a cup there.»

texto: Work out intention, references and replies in a short written conversation. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: the pronoun « y » can refer back to a place or an activity; « en » can replace an amount already mentioned. In this passage, «y» means «there».
